dimensional_safety_margin_mm.rationale: Project starting margin; not a Prusa Research dimensional guarantee.

nozzle_diameter_mm.rationale: Example common nozzle; verify installed hardware and slicer profile.

nominal_layer_height_mm.rationale: Example process setting, not a printer guarantee.

wall_thickness_warning_mm.rationale: Project starting point for the example nozzle; calibrate with slicer/material.

wall_thickness_critical_mm.rationale: Project review boundary, not a Prusa Research wall-thickness claim.

minimum_feature_warning_mm.rationale: Project feature proxy; material and slicer settings remain user-specific.

minimum_feature_critical_mm.rationale: Project review boundary, not a manufacturer claim.

overhang_warning_angle_deg.rationale: Project convention from horizontal; not a Prusa Research guarantee.

overhang_critical_angle_deg.rationale: Project review boundary; supports and bridges are not simulated.

build_plate_contact_tolerance_mm.rationale: Mesh contact tolerance, not a plate adhesion specification.

bridge_guidance.description: Review bridge flow and cooling in the selected PrusaSlicer process profile.

support_assumption.description: Support policy is not inferred from the printer model; review it in the slicer.

notes: Manufacturer fact is limited to cited build volume. All process thresholds are project defaults or user-configurable.
